intro: Rugby is Samoa's national sport, and Samoans star in rugby and the NFL worldwide.

chapters.title: Rugby
text: Manu Samoa reached the Rugby World Cup quarter-finals in 1991 and 1995. Samoan heritage players are common in the All Blacks and the NFL.

chapters.title: Other sports
text: Weightlifter Ele Opeloge won Samoa's first Olympic medal, a silver awarded in 2016 for the 2008 Games.

places.intro: Where Samoa's biggest sporting moments happen.
